gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-ubuntu-sans: Raw heading, tubular body: Capture Smallz stacks big-bodied lowercase while Ubuntu Sans, a modern sans-serif, bends copper-pipe strokes. Make the heading small and all that raw punch drains away.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-vend-sans: Vend Sans is a sans with a ruler-drawn, constant-width line and curves left wide open at the ends. Vend Sans can sit at text size under Capture Smallz, whose raw, tactical build does best large.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-yaldevi: Clean in outline, Yaldevi is a sans-serif with an e that opens clearly to the right and outsized lowercase. Capture Smallz, raw and tactical, shouts above it in big-bodied lowercase.
gen-dafont-carrington-fs-literata: Literata brings sturdy thin strokes, slightly heavier thick ones and wide-mouthed curves, which gives the calligraphic Carrington a bookish partner. Carrington is romantic but better kept to brief lines; Literata carries the paragraphs.
gen-dafont-carrington-fs-synonym: Carrington is romantic and understated, a calligraphic script stitched tightly from left to right. Synonym, a dependable sans with generous curve openings, takes the longer text, since the script wants only a word or two.
gen-dafont-carrington-outfit: A tightly stitched, calligraphic hand: that is Carrington. Outfit, a clean sans with cable-like curves that stop short of closing, keeps company with it nicely across a couple of lines.
